name: dorsaVi Ltd
summary: dorsaVi Ltd engages in the development and sale of motion analysis technologies in Australia, Europe, and the United States. It offers ViSafe, a wearable sensor technology that tracks, analyzes, and reports how employees move through their daily work lives and take the guess work out of workplace injuries and safety risks; and ViMove, a wearable sensor technology, which provides patient care and exercise plans, patient engagement and recovery programs, and new services and rehabilitation programs. The company also provides ViPerform, a wearable and wireless movement sensor technology that offers objective data to assess risk of sport injury and guide athletic training and recovery programs; and Telehealth solution. dorsaVi Ltd was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Kew, Australia.
